profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at GoDaddy
profile.summary:
Curious software engineer.
Ambitious to learn and adapt to new technologies. 
Exceptional communication skills. 
Dedicated team member and a top-notch troubleshooter.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
JavaScript, AngularJS, Node.js, Jasmine, Grunt, Git Stash Bitbucket, Visual Studio Code, React, Docker, Linux, ADA compliant websites, MongoDB, SAAS.

Deliver front-end accessibility features (low visibility mode, navigation bar ordering, email receipts ) for self-serve kiosks.
Reservation and profile preferences for our hotel management solution.
Improve responsiveness and usability of SAAS solutions.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Apprentice
positions.description:
C#, TypeScript, Azure portal SDK, OData API, Visual Studio Enterprise

Azure Security and Identity Team - worked on alerts for Azure Resources.

positions.title: Senior Information Technology Analyst
positions.description:
Administered Server/client model systems (Active Directory / VOIP/ Network switches )
Implemented Infrastructure Virtualization (Hyper-V, VMWare)

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer and Information Systems Security/Information Assurance

honors.title: Black Belt - Ruby on Rails
honors.description: The Black Belt certificate in Ruby on Rails proves when given a wireframe, the student can build a complete web app from scratch using the Ruby on Rails development stack.

honors.title: Black Belt - MEAN Stack
honors.description: I was one of very few to successfully complete the Black Belt Exam. Completing this test involves developing a full real world web application in under 4 hours. This test requires a mastery of Node.js,  Expresss MVC framework, Angular.js, and Mongoose with MongoDB. It proves the ability to work quickly and efficiently to meet very difficult deadlines.

volunteerExperiences.description: She’s Coding is an open-source project developed in cooperation with the documentary film CODE: Debugging the Gender Gap. She’s Coding provides education, resources, and actionable guidelines for anyone who wants to help bridge the gender gap in the field of computer science.

Assisted with the Draft Day Training Camp Event @ WeWork in Seattle, WA.  Draft day helped candidates gain industry insights, get their resume reviewed, go through mock interviews, and receive career mentoring.
